pattern: ^SELECT .+ FROM ([a-z]+) JOIN ([a-z]+) ON ([a-z]+\.[a-z]+) = ([a-z]+\.[a-z]+) GROUP BY (\w+)\.id ORDER BY SUM\((\w+)\.\w+\) DESC LIMIT 1
correction: Replace the ORDER BY clause with ORDER BY count(*), and change the grouping to use the joined table alias instead of ship.id.

metadata.description: This rule identifies queries that order by the sum of a column rather than the count of rows, which can lead to incorrect results.
